sentences.text: Bring your own model means using, inside a prompt, a model that you deployed in Foundry.
It is like bringing your own tool to the workshop.
You only have to follow some precise rules.
Use it when you need a specific model from your team, for example to classify support tickets.
In the prompt, you open the Model drop-down, select the plus sign, and choose to connect a model from Azure AI Foundry.
You type the deployment name and the base model name exactly as they appear in Foundry.
Do not type them from memory.
Only chat completion models are supported, and the endpoint must end in slash chat completions.
A Responses endpoint gives the error Resource not found.
Models in the G P T five family and later are not supported.
These rules are very specific, and the exam asks about them a lot.
The admin governs it with the Azure AI Foundry connector in the Power Platform data policies.
And the usage is billed separately in Azure, not with the Copilot Studio rates.
In other words, it is not charged with Copilot Studio credits.
If the exam asks why a model fails, the answer is that it is in the G P T five family or the endpoint is not slash chat completions.
And here is the trap: thinking it is billed in Copilot Studio, when it is billed separately in Azure.
